violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children (26 TAC §746.1201(2))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children
violation_type.typical_finding: Evidence obtained during the investigation shows that a staff member was not relating to children with courtesy or respect as they called children names that were not kind.

finding_variants.text: Evidence obtained during the investigation shows that a staff member was not relating to children with courtesy or respect as they called children names that were not kind.
Based on a review of the documentation pertaining to the incident, it was determined that a caregiver did not exhibit patience when relating to a child in care who needed assistance redressing.

This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS investigation. A caregiver did not demonstrate patience with a child during naptime.  This is evidenced through the caregiver?s actions towards the child such as pointing her finger in the child?s face, patting the child roughly on the back, and aggressively placing the child on a nap mat.
Caregiver was observed grabbing and forcing a child sit down during lunchtime.
The caregiver failed to treat the children in care with respect and was not empathetic to the needs of the children.
Based on evidence gathered during the investigation,  a caregiver failed to exercise respect and patience with a child.

Later, the caregiver was heard "shushing" children again putting their finger on their lip and telling children to be quiet.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children: This standard was evaluated as part of a DFPS investigation and was found to be deficient. It was determined a caregiver was not patient with an infant who would not eat from a bottle.  The caregiver moved the infant from side to side in a jerking motion, causing the infant to hit their head. The caregiver was forcing the bottle in the infant's mouth when the infant did not want to take it.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children: One caregiver demonstrated a lack of patience and respect for a child in her care while having children take turns going the bathroom. The caregiver used an aggressive tone when demanding the children hurry up and sit down and hurry up and dry their hands. Every statement lacked patience and sensitivity to the children. Additionally telling children that they will never get a sticker for how they are acting, and they won't get to play at all the rest of the day.

Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Relate to Children: One caregiver demonstrated a lack of patience and respect for a child in her care while talking in an aggressive tone to the child while the child was upset and actively crying. The caregiver told the crying child that they weren't really crying for real and to stop crying in a loud and aggressive tone.
